title: New Agentic Browsing category added to PageSpeed API
summary: The PageSpeed Insights API now supports a new audit category called AGENTIC_BROWSING to evaluate site compatibility with AI agents.
details: A new enum value `AGENTIC_BROWSING` has been added to the `category` parameter of the `pagespeedapi.runpagespeed` method. This category is designed to measure a website's ability to be rendered and navigated by agentic browsing systems, signaling a shift toward optimizing web content for AI-driven consumers rather than just human users.
